title: Match the ratio to the media

do.text: Frame each photo or video at the ratio it was made in (16:9 video, 4:5 portrait posts).

dont.text: Don't force portrait media into a wide frame: the subject is cropped away.

do.text: Cap tall frames to a column's width so the rest of the page stays in view.

dont.text: Don't let a 9:16 frame fill the width: it pushes everything else out of view.
